tei:div.tei:p: "!# rdo rje drag po rtsal gyi phyi sgrub padma'i ga'u bzhugs so:༙

zil gnon gsang ba'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo:༙ sbas yul bka' yi tha ram:༙ rdo rje drag po zil gnon rtsal gyi phyi sgrub padma'i ga'u ni:༙ sngon 'gro sbyor ba stegs bu gang rigs la:༙ zil gnon sku 'bag tsakli bum pa dang:༙ gtor tshogs sman rag mchod pa gang 'byor bsham:༙ skyabs sems yan lag bdun pa sngon du btang:༙ rang mdun slob dpon padma spyan drangs nas:༙ gnyis med rang la bstims nas chos ma lus:༙ stong pa'i ngang las sa bon yi ge hrī:༙ don gnyis byas pas tshur 'dus skad cig las:༙ bdag nyid rdo rje drag po zil gnon rtsal:༙ sku mdog dmar po khro tshul zhi ba'i nyams:༙ phyag g.yas rtse dgu rdo rje rwa gdengs phyar:༙ g.yon pa sdigs mdzub dregs pa'i snying phreng 'dzin:༙ sku la zab chen mthing dmar sum brtsegs dang:༙ chos gos dmar po ber phyam smug po mnabs:༙ pad zhwa khyung ru rdo rje rgod ldem can:༙ ro steng brkyang bskum me rlung 'khyil dbus bzhugs:༙ gnas lngar sku yi lha lnga me long gzugs:༙ phyogs mtshams brgyad du ma mo ke'u rī brgyad:༙ phyi rim 'khor lo rtsibs bcur phyogs skyong bcu:༙ rang rang cha lugs dpag med 'tshubs par bsam:༙ rang 'dra spyan drangs gnyis med bstim mchod 'bul:༙ dbang bskur rgyas gdab rang gi thugs ka yi:༙ hūm̐ dmar me 'dra 'bar ba'i mtha' skor du:༙ hūm̐ a ka ya:༙ ha a ma ra:༙ a ya ma du ru tsa sha na trig nan sbur thum dza dza:༙ dha lo sha bu wa ma a nṛ tri:༙ siddhi pha la dza dza:༙ khro chu'i 'khyud mo lta bu 'khor ba las:༙ sku gang phyir lud me 'bar snod bcud khengs:༙ drag sngags hūm̐ dang mtshon cha skar ltar 'khrugs:༙ khro bo khro mo glog ltar gar nyams 'khyugs:༙ snod bcud gnyis sbyangs dregs pa kun srog bsdus:༙ yar 'phros sangs rgyas byang sems rig 'dzin dang:༙ mkha' 'gro dam can kun gyi byin rlabs bsdus:༙ bdag dang lha tshogs thugs ka'i hūm̐ dang ni:༙

dkyil 'khor gzhal yas 'ja' tshon 'bar:༙ padma nyi zla zab 'bol steng:༙ bdag nyid rdo rje thod phreng rtsal:༙ dkar dmar rdo rje thod pa bsnams:༙ rin chen rus rgyan thor tshugs can:༙ gcer bu phyed skyil sgeg pa'i gzugs:༙ mtsho rgyal dkar mo nor bu dang:༙ thod pa thogs pa yab la 'khril:༙ yab yum zung 'jug bde stong ngang:༙ sku yi nang du 'khor lo lnga:༙ padma'i me tog dkar dmar ser:༙ ljang mthing 'dab ldan gsal ba yi:༙ spyi bor 'dab ma dkar po'i dbus:༙ badzra gu ru yab yum dkar:༙ mgrin par 'dab ma ser po'i dbus:༙ ratna gu ru yab yum ser:༙ thugs kar 'dab ma mthing ga'i dbus:༙ buddha gu ru yab yum mthing:༙ lte bar 'dab ma dmar po'i dbus:༙ padma gu ru yab yum dmar:༙ gsang gnas 'dab ma ljang gsal dbus:༙ karma gu ru yab yum ljang:༙ yab rnams rdo rje dril bu 'dzin:༙ yum rnams gri gug thod khrag bsnams:༙ rin chen rus rgyan thor cog dang:༙ dar dpyang snyan rgyan brkyang bskum gar:༙ thams cad bde stong dbyer med gsal:༙ rang rang thugs srog hūm̐ gi mthar:༙ gsang ba'i snying po g.yas su 'khor:༙ rang sgra bdud rtsi dkar dmar mthing:༙ lud nas sku gang bde ba rgyas:༙ yab yum gnyis med bde bas myos:༙ bung ba rtsi yis rtag myos ltar:༙ gyur par bsams la sngags 'di bzlas:༙ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru padma thod phreng rtsal dzñā na ḍā ki nī badzra sa ma ya dzaḥsiddhi pha la hūm̐ dza:༙ gsang sngags yi ge gsang ba'i sngags:༙ bde gshegs kun gyi snying po yin:༙ 'bum phrag gsum bzlas mchog thun 'grub:༙ bdun gyis bla ma'i sa la 'gro:༙ mchog gi dngos grub sangs rgyas 'grub:༙ rtags ni 'ja' tshon me tog dang:༙ zhal mjal gsung bstan yi ge'i tshogs:༙ bar snang shar dang rdo la 'byung:༙ khye 'u pho mo bag dro dang:༙ lha dang bla mas dngos grub ster:༙ phreng ba phyag mtshan dar phyar dang:༙ rol mo dung 'bud dri bzang 'thul:༙

rten la 'od dang me tog 'phro:༙ bdud rtsi khol zhing 'phyur ba dang:༙ gtor ma khol zhing zhu bar 'byung:༙ de tshe dngos grub blang bar bya:༙ gnyis pa bdag nyid thod phreng rtsal:༙ gsal ba'i spyi bo'i rtsa 'dab dbus:༙ badzra gu ru yab yum dkar:༙ thugs ka'i sngags yig dkar po 'phros:༙ lus ngag nad gdon sdig sgrib zhi:༙ phyir 'phros 'jigs brgyad zhi bar bsam:༙ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru dzñā na ḍā ki nī siddhi pha la hūm̐:༙ de bzlas 'jigs brgyad zhi bar 'gyur:༙ mgrin par ratna yab yum ser:༙ thugs kar sngags phreng ser po 'phros:༙ lus gang tshe dang bsod nams rgyas:༙ phyir 'phros 'byor drug rgyas par bsam:༙ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ratna gu ru dzñā na ḍā ki nī siddhi pha la hūm̐:༙ de bzlas 'byor drug rgyas par 'gyur:༙ lte bar padma yab yum dmar:༙ thugs kar sngags phreng dmar po 'phros:༙ lus gang byin rlabs nus pa 'bar:༙ phyir 'phros snang srid brtan g.yo 'dus:༙ oṃ āḥhūm̐ padma gu ru dzñā na ḍā ki nī siddhi pha la hūm̐:༙ de bzlas khams gsum dbang du 'dus:༙ gsang bar karma yab yum ljang:༙ thugs kar sngags phreng ljang gu 'phros:༙ lus gang bar chad rang bzhin dag:༙ phyir 'phros dgra bgegs ma lus brlag:༙ oṃ āḥhūm̐ karma gu ru dzñā na ḍā ki nī siddhi pha la hūm̐:༙ de bzlas dgra bgegs byad ma brlag:༙ thugs kar buddha yab yum mthing:༙ thugs srog sngags phreng mthing 'od 'phros:༙ lus gang mchog gi ting 'dzin skyes:༙ phyir 'phros rtsa gsum byin rlabs 'dus:༙ oṃ āḥhūm̐ buddha gu ru dzñā na ḍā ki nī siddhi pha la hūm̐:༙ de bzlas mchog gi dngos grub thob:༙ las bzhi'i sngags kyi sham bsgyur ni:༙ shāntiṃ ku ru ye swā hā:༙ puṣṭiṃ ku ru ye swā hā:༙ wa shaṃ ku ru ye swā hā:༙ mā ra ya phaṭa:༙ dgos dus so so'i sngags sham gdags:༙ me la sbyin sreg btab pa dang:༙ sa la tsha tshwa gdab pa dang:༙

rlung la bsang dang dud pa btang:༙ chu la gtor ma btang bas 'grub:༙ gnas kyi lha dang sbyar ba na:༙ spyi bo yab yum chu yi khams:༙ mgrin pa yab yum sa yi khams:༙ lte ba yab yum me yi khams:༙ gsang gnas yab yum rlung gi khams:༙ snying gar yab yum nam mkha'i khams:༙ rang rang so so'i las sbyor ni:༙ rgyas par gzhan nas bshad pa ltar:༙ chu phyar gtor nas gtor ma btang:༙ sa la tsha tshwa kha dog bsgyur:༙ me la sbyin sreg mchod la bsreg:༙ rlung la thun gtor rdzas dud btang:༙ nam mkha' ting 'dzin stong nyid bsgom:༙ de ltar las la sbyar shes na:༙ mi 'grub pa ni gcig kyang med:༙ 'byung ba lnga la dbang bsgyur bas:༙ phrin las bzhi la thogs pa med:༙ gsang na dngos grub myur du thob:༙ sa ma ya:༙ rgya rgya rgya:༙ :༙ rig 'dzin stag sham rdo rje'i gter ma'o// 1$0000250 ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ rdo rje drag po rtsal snang srid zil gyis gnon pa'i gsang sgrub nus pa rang 'bar bzhugs so:༙ 1$0000300 ྈྈྈྈྈ rdo rje drag po rtsal la phyag 'tshal lo:༙ rdo rje drag po padma zil gnon gyi:༙ gsang sgrub nus pa rang 'bar bstan pa ni:༙ brten rdzas phur pa lcags sam seng ldeng bya:༙ phyi nang mchod rdzas gang 'dzom bkod nas bsgrub:༙ bdag nyid skad cig dran rdzogs nyi shar ltar:༙ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ mthing me 'od 'bar:༙ yar mar don byas dregs pa'i srog bsdus nas:༙ tshur thim yongs gyur bdag nyid zil gnon rtsal:༙ dkar dmar mdangs ldan khro 'dzum dbang gi sku:༙ za 'og dkar dmar mthing gsum phod kha la:༙ smug ber chos gos dmar la snam sbyar ser:༙ thang sham lham dang mu tig do shal can:༙ phyag g.yas rtse dgu rdo rje mkha' la phyar:༙ phyag g.yon sdigs mdzub snying phreng phur pas gzir:༙ snyan cha mgur chu rgyan drug rus pas spras:༙ dbu la she'u'i snyan zhu khyung gshog lding:༙ nyi zla mu tig gser rgyan dar sna 'phur:༙ rdo rje rgod ldem theg pa yongs rdzogs rtags:༙

padma chos 'byung nyi zla srin po'i steng:༙ brkyang bskum snang srid zil gnon skur gsal ba'i:༙ spyi bor 'od dpag med pa spyan ras gzigs:༙ gu ru padma yab yum gcer bu la:༙ mthing nag rdo rje 'chang chen yab yum gsal:༙ dpral bar khrag zhag chos 'byung dmar smug klong:༙ 'jam dpal nā ga raksha sku mdog nag:༙ zhal gcig phyag gnyis rigs bdag 'jam dpal dbyangs:༙ dur khrod chas brgyad 'jigs pa'i dug rlangs 'khrigs:༙ phyag g.yas lcags sdig g.yon pas dug sbrul 'gyed:༙ sku smad sbrul mjug khrag zhags mtsho nang 'khyil:༙ klu bdud pho mo'i gdan la 'gying bar bsam:༙ mgrin par zla gam padma nyi zla'i steng:༙ rta mgrin dbang chen dmar nag lcags sreg mdog:༙ zhal gcig khro bo spyi bor rta ljang 'tsher:༙ phyag g.yas tho ba me 'bar tshwa tshwa phyar:༙ g.yon pas me zhags stong gsum dgra bgegs 'ching:༙ dur khrod chas brgyad 'jigs pa'i sku mchog la:༙ glang ko stag lpags sbrul chun mi mgo'i phreng:༙ me dpung dbus su brkyang bskum bam ro gnon:༙ thugs kyi 'od lnga padma zla ba'i steng:༙ kun tu bzang po bla med rdo rje 'chang:༙ sku mdog mthing nag rin chen rus pas brgyan:༙ rdo rje dril 'dzin rdo rje phag mo dmar:༙ gri thod thogs nas yab yum gnyis med sbyor:༙ lte bar chos 'byung gru gsum dur khrod du:༙ mgon po dmar nag khro gtum gel pa'i gzugs:༙ gri gug thod bsnams ber brtsegs dmar smug ljang:༙ mi lpags rked chings bing btsugs dur khrod chas:༙ sag ti dmar po'i lham bcas tshogs bdag steng:༙ che ba'i rje btsan brkyang bskum stabs kyis bzhugs:༙ gsang ba gru gsum dmar nag khrag mtsho la:༙ dregs pa kun 'dul khyab 'jug rā hu la:༙ me mdag lta bu'i sku la dud pa 'khrigs:༙ spyan stong me dpung lta bu tshwa tshwa 'phro:༙ phyag g.yas ral gri g.yon pas mda' gzhu bsnams:༙ sku smad sbrul mjug khrag mtsho 'khyil bar bzhugs:༙

phyogs mtshams brgyad du ke'u rī ma mo brgyad:༙ rang rang cha lugs ma mo rol pa'i tshul:༙ ro yi steng du brkyang bskum gar gyis bzhugs:༙ phyi rol 'khor lo 'bar ba rtsibs bcu la:༙ lha dang gshin rje klu dang gnod sbyin dang:༙ drang srong srin po rlung dang 'byung po brgyad:༙ sa bdag nyi zla dregs pa'i sde dpon bcu:༙ cha lugs yab yum rang rang dpung dang bcas:༙ ma yengs me rlung klong du gsal bar bskyed:༙ rang rang thugs kar hūm̐ yig sa bon cig:༙ sku mdog dang mthun kha dog so sor gsal:༙ tha mar drag sngags me phung shig shig tu:༙ 'khor ba'i shugs kyis me 'bar snod bcud khengs:༙ srid gsum gdug pa kun bsregs thal bar gyur:༙ thams cad sbyong ba'i nus pa bdag la 'dus:༙ sems can kun sbyangs sangs rgyas byang sems dang:༙ rig 'dzin yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong bcas:༙ 'dus pa cher 'dus bdag la 'dus pa yis:༙ 'jig rten 'das dang ma 'das 'khor 'das kyi:༙ brtan g.yo snang srid bdag la 'dus par bsam:༙ yang snying gsang ba'i sngags 'di dag par zlos:༙ hūm̐ a ka ya:༙ ha a ma ra:༙ a ya ma du ru tsa sha na trig nan sbur thum dza dza:༙ dha lo sha bu wa ma a nṛ tri siddhi pha la dza dza:༙ 'gyur med gsang sngags rdo rje'i snying po 'di:༙ pha rgyud ma rgyud gnyis med ma ning rgyud:༙ bla med yang dag rgyud sde chen po bzhi:༙ theg dgu a ti'i rtse mo yang ti'i snying:༙ 'jig rten 'das dang ma 'das sarba yi:༙ srog rnams kun 'dus brjod phangs gsang sngags 'dis:༙ bdag 'dra padmas o rgyan mkha' 'gro'i gling:༙ phra men mu stegs mkha' 'gro thams cad btul:༙ rgya gar mu stegs rgya nag dze ghṛ dang:༙ zhang zhung bon nag bod kyi lha 'dre dang:༙ ma rungs srin po thams cad btul ba'i sngags:༙ spel phangs lnga brgyar dregs pa sde brgyad phyur:༙ khyad par da lta dam la ma thogs pa'i:༙ glo bur lhags pa'i mi dang mi ma yin:༙

bsdu chog dmigs med rtag chad mtha' bsal te:༙ las rim bcu bzhi rjes kyi rim pa'o:༙ sa ma ya:༙ rgya rgya rgya:༙ sde brgyad dregs pa gnyis kyi tsitta dha na ra:༙:༙ ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ mtshams gcod pa ni:༙

hūm̐:༙ nga ni bde gshegs kun 'dus thod phreng rtsal:༙ sku las 'od zer me dpung phyogs bcur 'bar:༙ gsung gi hūm̐ sgra mtshon cha 'bar ba'i gur:༙ thugs las 'od 'phros khro tshogs skar ltar 'khrug:༙ rang byung ye grol chen por mtshams chod cig:༙ hūm̐ gu ru badzra kro ta dzwa la raṃ:༙ bhandha baṃ hūm̐ bhrūm̐ tsakra rakṣa hūm̐:༙ gnyis pa brda sgo dbye ba ni:༙ hūm̐:༙ 'khor 'das ye nas sku gsum bla ma'i ngang:༙ ma rig gnyis 'dzin log ltas sgo bcad pa:༙ rang gsal snying po don dam rtogs pa'i phyir:༙ rang rig bla mar mjal phyir sgo dbye 'tshal:༙ gu ru bhrūm̐ pra be sha ya phaṭa:༙ gsum pa brda phyag 'tshal ba ni:༙ hūm̐:༙ 'khor 'das rang byung bla ma lha yi ngang:༙ rang rig mtha' dbus med kyang ma rtogs gol:༙ rang rig bla mar rtogs phyir brda phyag 'tshal:༙ gu ru na mo pū ru sha ya ho:༙ bzhi pa dam bca' ba ni:༙ hūm̐:༙ sngon tshe gu ru khyed dang smon lam gcig:༙ 'di bzung rang sems bla mar ma rtogs bar:༙ srog gi phyir yang mi gtang bzung bar bgyi:༙ gu ru tsitta badzra sa ma ya dza:༙ de nas lnga pa byin dbab pa ni:༙ hūm̐:༙ byin chen phob cig o rgyan rig 'dzin rje:༙ byin gyis rlobs shig yi dam gu ru rje:༙ dngos grub stsol cig mkha' 'gro padma 'byung:༙ bar chad sol cig chos skyong kun 'dus rje:༙ phrin las sgrubs shig dam can thod phreng rtsal:༙ oṃ gu ru padma ha ri ni sa ā be sha ya hriṃ hriṃ pheṃ pheṃ dza dza:༙ drug pa byin brlab pa ni:༙ hūm̐:༙ rang nyid gu ru lhar gsal thugs ka nas:༙ oṃ dkar āḥdamar hūm̐ mthing hoḥser 'phros:༙ phyi nang mchod rdzas thams cad bsregs sbyangs bkrus:༙ oṃ gyis 'dod yon mchod sprin nam mkha' gang:༙ āḥyis zag med bdud rtsis lha tshogs dgyes:༙ hūm̐ gis dri ma sbyangs pas ro bcud ldan:༙ hoḥyis snang srid mtha' klas yongs bkang gyur:༙ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ho:༙

sngon 'gro'i le'u drug pa rdzogs so:༙ rgya:༙ dngos gzhi ting 'dzin 'byung rim ni:༙ hūm̐:༙ chos sku mi 'gyur 'khor 'das chos rnams kun:༙ ye nas bdag med spros dang bral ba las:༙ kun snang sna tshogs snang ba gsal mdangs ye shes che:༙ snang ba'i dus na ye nas dngos pos stong:༙ rgyu yi spros dang bral ba skye med chos dbyings ngang:༙ rang byung byang chub snying po bde ba che:༙ rtsal snang ma 'gag rig pa hūm̐ du shar:༙ 'byung rim hūm̐ las sna tshogs rang byung 'od lnga 'phros:༙ ma bcos lhun grub gsang chen yum lnga'i klong:༙ e yaṃ raṃ suṃ keṃ ra bhrūm̐:༙ gzhal yas lha gsal ba ni:༙ bhrūm̐ las rang byung dur khrod gzhal yas khang:༙ gru chad bar khyams sgo khyud rgyan rnams rdzogs:༙ rin chen rtsig pa 'dod yon lha mo 'khrigs:༙ pha gu rin chen drwa phyed mda' yab mdzes:༙ rta babs gdugs tog chos 'khor khor yug rdzogs:༙ stong pa'i rang bzhin phyi nang zang thal gsal:༙ dur khrod 'od 'bar pho brang lhun gyis grub:༙ ngo mtshar rmad byung bla ma'i gzhal yas khang:༙ lha gsal ba ni:༙ de dbus chos 'byung pad sdong snying po zlum:༙ thabs shes nyi zla rang byung zab 'bol steng:༙ dregs pa pho mo byi chings bsnol ba'i steng:༙ hūm̐ las bdag nyid zil gnon kun 'dus rtsal:༙ dkar dmar khro 'dzum gzi brjid 'od phung 'bar:༙ pad zhwa mthon mthing khyung ru rgod ldem can:༙ sku la zab ber smug khra sprin chen ris:༙ phod kha mthing la chos gos dmar po gsol:༙ le brgan gser rgyan pa tra mig mang ris:༙ phyag g.yas gnam lcags rdo rje rtse dgu phyar:༙ g.yon pas dregs pa sde bcu'i snying phreng 'dren:༙ me dpung dmar nag klong du brkyang bskum bzhugs:༙ spyi bor gu ru yid bzhin nor bu ni:༙ dmar po rdo rje dril bsnams skyil krung bzhugs:༙ longs spyod rdzogs tshul mtsho rgyal dkar mo 'khril:༙ gzhon nu'i lang tsho nor bu'i thod pa can:༙

dpral bar 'jam dpal smug nag 'jigs pa'i gzugs:༙ zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyi bor ye shes sems:༙ phyag g.yas sdig pa nag po g.yon dug sbrul:༙ sku smad sbrul mjug rakta'i mtsho nang du:༙ klu bdud pho mo ro yi gdan la bzhugs:༙ mgrin par dregs 'dul rta mgrin dmar nag khros:༙ zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyi bor rta mgo ljang:༙ phyag g.yas me 'bar tho ba g.yon me zhags:༙ dur khrod chas brgyad brkyang bskum ro gdan bzhugs:༙ thugs kar kun bzang rdor 'chang sku mdog mthing:༙ rin chen rgyan ldan phag mo dmar mo 'khril:༙ yab yum gnyis med rdo rje dril bu bsnams:༙ snang stong zung 'jug padma zla gdan bzhugs:༙ lte bar mgon po dmar nag gri thod bsnams:༙ dur khrod chas dang ber dmar sag lh+wam bcas:༙ rab 'jigs tshogs bdag glang sna'i gdan la bzhugs:༙ gsang gnas dregs pa khyab 'jug rā hu la:༙ srin gzugs zhal bcu bya rog mgo bo can:༙ dmar nag me 'bar ral gri mda' gzhu bsnams:༙ sku smad sbrul mjug lte bar srin po'i zhal:༙ khrag zhags mtsho nang bam ro'i gdan la bzhugs:༙ thams cad ma lus rang rang 'khor dang bcas:༙ phyogs mtshams brgyad du ma mo ke'u rī brgyad:༙ phra men bzhi yi sgo srung bcas pa gsal:༙ dregs pa chen po sde bcu phyi rol bsgom:༙ spyan 'dren ni:༙ hūm̐:༙ dur khrod gsang chen bsnol ma nas:༙ rje btsun padma thod phreng rtsal:༙ sku la 'od phung gzi brjid 'bar:༙ rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyis bskor:༙ mkha' 'gro chos skyong sprin ltar gtibs:༙ chos skyong dam can glog ltar 'khyug:༙ khyed kyi rjes su bdag sgrub kyis:༙ byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsol:༙ hūm̐:༙ dbu la thor tshugs rgyan gyis spras:༙ dar gyi cod pan pu ru ru:༙ sku la 'od phung lhabs se lhab:༙ phyag gdub zhabs gdub si li li:༙ rol mo mang po di ri ri:༙ dpa' bos bro brdung khrabs se khrab:༙

dpa' mos glu len kyu ru ru:༙ mkha' 'gros gar byed shigs se shig:༙ hūm̐ gi snang glu di ri ri:༙ phaṭa kyi brda skad sangs se sang:༙ byin rlabs sprin phung thibs se thib:༙ dngos grub char 'bab si li li:༙ 'chi med na bun thu lu lu:༙ nyams dang shes pa bun ne bun:༙ sku gsung thugs kyi byin chen phob:༙ lus ngag yid gsum smin grol nas:༙ gu ru chen pos byin gyis rlobs:༙ hūm̐:༙ gsol ba 'debs so o rgyan rin po che:༙ byin gyis rlobs shig gu ru thugs rje can:༙ bdag sogs 'gro la dbang skur byin gyis rlobs:༙ bgegs rigs bdud dang 'byung po'i bar chad zlog:༙ mchog dang thun mong dngos grub bstsal du gsol:༙ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru padma thod phreng rtsal badzra sa ma ya dzaḥsiddhi pha la hūm̐:༙ arghaṃ 'bul ba ni:༙ hūm̐:༙ skye med rnam dag chos dbyings dkyil 'khor du:༙ o rgyan rig 'dzin thod phreng lha tshogs la:༙ 'gro kun nyon mongs bag chags bsal ba'i phyir:༙ arghaṃ khrus chab 'bul gyis bzhes par mdzod:༙ ma hā gu ru arghaṃ pra wa sad ka ra hūm̐:༙ gdan 'bul ba ni:༙ hūm̐:༙ chos 'byung rang bzhin gsal ba'i dkyil 'khor du:༙ ge sar pad sdong 'dab stong mdangs ldan dbus:༙ nyi zla 'od 'bar 'bol brtsegs ro gdan dbus:༙ rigs 'dus o rgyan chen po bzhugs su gsol:༙ ma hā gu ru sa ma ya tiṣṭha lhan:༙ de nas phyag 'bul ba ni:༙ hūm̐:༙ gsal stong grags stong rig stong mkhyen gsum ldan:༙ sku gsung thugs yon phrin las lhun gyis grub:༙ gu ru zil gnon rtsal la phyag 'tshal lo:༙ gu ru ma hā kṣa ni na mo hūm̐:༙ de nas mchod tshogs 'bul ba ni:༙ hūm̐:༙ rigs 'dus o rgyan gu ru'i lha tshogs la:༙ dngos 'byor yid sprul phyi nang gsang mchod 'bul:༙ mchod sprin rgya mtsho nam mkha'i mtha' klas kun:༙ rang gi thugs nas me tog dkar mo dang:༙ bdug spos ser mo mar me dmar mo dang:༙

dri chab sngon mo zhal zas mthing ga sogs:༙ sil snyan ljang mor sprul nas mchod par 'bul:༙ gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos la sogs:༙ rigs 'dus o rgyan chen po'i tshogs la 'bul:༙ 'gro kun tshogs rdzogs brtser dgongs bzhes su gsol:༙ hūm̐:༙ rang gi thugs nas rdo rje lha mo'i tshogs:༙ gdugs dang rgyal mtshan ba dan lda ldi dang:༙ phye ma phur ma sman dang rin chen rigs:༙ dar zab 'bru bcud rgyal srid bkra shis rdzas:༙ lha mi'i 'dod yon sna tshogs 'char bas mchod:༙ hūm̐:༙ mtshan ldan rdo rje bhandha'i snod mchog tu:༙ gdod nas rnam dag rtsa ba brgyad la sbyar:༙ lo 'dab stong gi bcud mchog a mṛ ta:༙ dug lnga sel byed sman gyi mchod pa 'bul:༙ hūm̐:༙ mtshan ldan padma bhandha 'khor yug tu:༙ chos nyid dbyings las byung ba'i rang byung rdzas:༙ de nyid ma bcos yum gyi bha gar 'khyil:༙ chags med bde chen rakta'i mchod pa 'bul:༙ hūm̐:༙ thabs shes dbyer med thod zhal 'khor yug tu:༙ sha mchog lnga dang 'bru sman lnga sbyar ba'i:༙ bcud ldan ye shes lnga ldan gtor ma 'di:༙ rigs 'dus ma hā gu ru'i tshogs la 'bul:༙ hūm̐:༙ sbyor ba thabs shes yab yum gnyis su med:༙ sgrol ba gnyis 'dzin re dogs dug lnga dag:༙ dgyes pa'i gar dang bde stong zag med glu:༙ sna tshogs theg pa chen po'i nyams kyis mchod:༙ ma hā gu ru sarba pū tsa ho:༙ de nas bstod pa ni:༙ hūm̐:༙ dmigs med mkha' ltar khyab pa'i ngo bo la:༙ yon tan gter 'byung nor bu rin chen mdzod:༙ 'gro ba'i don brtson stong nyid bde chen rgyal:༙ dmigs pa med cing dmigs pa'i tshul gyis bstod:༙ hūm̐:༙ chos kyi dbyings las ma g.yos sku gsung thugs:༙ don dam spros bral mnyam pa'i ngang tshul can:༙ gzugs sku ma nges shel gyi me long bzhin:༙ 'gro bas so sor rtog kyang dngos grub ci bzhin pa:༙ rang gi lhag pa'i bsam pas bya ba thams cad 'grub:༙

de yi ngo bos 'gro don de 'grub 'gyur:༙ sku gsung thugs kyi thugs rje mthar thug med:༙ mi gnas sprul pas dbyings su sgrol ba la:༙ rang gi dam tshig nyid las 'da' dka' ba'i:༙ dpal chen khrag 'thung khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod:༙ hūm̐:༙ dug lnga dbang sdud ma hā gu ru rdo rje'i sku:༙ mnyam par don ston dpa' bo chen po dbang chen longs spyod rdzogs:༙ srid gsum sgrol mdzad thugs rje chen po sprul pa'i sku:༙ dbyer med snyoms mdzad ro gcig bde ba chen po'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod:༙ hūm̐:༙ bcom ldan dpal ldan padma'i dngos:༙ gsung gi rdo rje'i rang bzhin la:༙ rta mchog dbang gi sku la bstod:༙ hūm̐:༙ 'khor lo'i ded dpon bcom ldan 'das:༙ sku yi rdo rje'i rang bzhin la:༙ 'jam dpal dbyangs la phyag 'tshal bstod:༙ hūm̐:༙ stong pa'i ngang tshul bcom ldan 'das:༙ thugs kyi rdo rje'i rang bzhin la:༙ kun bzang yab yum phyag 'tshal bstod:༙ hūm̐:༙ sna tshogs cha byad bcom ldan 'das:༙ yon tan rdo rje'i rang bzhin la:༙ dpal ldan mgon po'i tshogs la bstod:༙ hūm̐:༙ khyab brdal blang dor med pa'i bcom ldan 'das:༙ phrin las rdo rje'i rang bzhin la:༙ gza' bdud chen por phyag 'tshal bstod:༙ hūm̐:༙ gnas brgyad tshogs dag ma mo'i tshogs:༙ zhing bcu sgrol byed ded dpon tshogs:༙ phra men sgo ma la sogs pa'i:༙ zil gnon bla ma dregs pa'i tshogs:༙ sgo gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal bstod:༙ rgyas par bstod bskul ltar du bya:༙ de nas dzap bzlas dzap bstod rim pa ni:༙ hūm̐:༙ dkyil 'khor yang gsang lha yi tshogs:༙ rigs 'dus bla ma'i lha tshogs la:༙ bskyed rim ting 'dzin mchod pa 'di:༙ rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i sku la 'bul:༙ sku yi byin rlabs lus la stsol:༙ snying po 'dzab kyi mchod pa 'di:༙ rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i gsung la 'bul:༙ gsung gi byin rlabs ngag la stsol:༙ bde stong ye shes mchod pa 'di:༙

rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i thugs la 'bul:༙ thugs kyi byin rlabs sems la stsol:༙ bdag nyid lha la lha nyid bdag:༙ bdag dang lha gnyis dbyer med pa:༙ snang srid dag pa rab 'byams pas:༙ gu ru rdo rje'i dngos grub stsol:༙ dzap ni:༙ hūm̐ a ka ya:༙ ha a ma ra:༙ a ya ma du ru tsa sha na:༙ trig nan:༙ sbur thum dza dza:༙ dha lo sha:༙ bu wa ma:༙ a nṛ tri:༙ sid dhi pha la dza dza:༙ tsheg bar so bdun yig 'bru bzhi bcu tham:༙ 'khor 'das ye shes kun gyi spyi srog yin:༙ 'bru 'bum song na snang srid g.yo zhing 'gul:༙ tshe gcig rig 'dzin bla ma'i go 'phang 'grub:༙ bye ba bzlas na sde brgyad dregs pa kun:༙ bsam pa tsam gyis bran du nges par khol:༙ 'bum phrag bdun gyis las bzhi thogs pa med:༙ 'bum phrag gsum gyis phyi nang bar chad sel:༙ snyigs dus 'gong po kun gyi tho ba yin:༙ sbas yul 'grim pa kun gyi lam yig yin:༙ mnan gtad byed dang gter 'don byed kun gyi:༙ snang srid bka' la nyan pa'i bka' tham yin:༙ 'di las zab pa gzhan du sbas re kan:༙ ྈ dngos gzhi'i le'u bcu gnyis pa rdzogs so:༙ tha 'bra:༙ dam rgya:༙ de nas tshogs kyi rim pa ni:༙ tshogs bsham sbyang zhing byin gyis brlab:༙ tshogs zhing spyan 'dren tshogs phud 'bul:༙ bar pa bshags shing tha ma bstab:༙ slob dpon drangs dang lhag ma bsngo:༙ bskul dang chad brtan rta bro brdung:༙ dngos grub blang dang bshags pa bya:༙ bkra shis bsngo smon dkyil 'khor bsdu:༙ rgyun khyer brtul zhugs bstan pa'o:༙ tshogs bsham gzhi gdan gang rung la:༙ gal dang chang dang sha dang shing thog rigs:༙ thag thug spod dang 'byor tshogs legs par bsham:༙ gnyis pa sbyang zhing byin gyis brlab pa ni:༙ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ:༙ oṃ āḥhūm̐:༙ lan gsum/ oṃ:༙ padma bhandha rdo rje'i snod nang du:༙ sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga las sbyar ba'i bcud:༙ chos dbyings nam mkha' mnyam par zad med spel:༙ rdo rje me rlung thod par sbyor ba yi:༙

tshogs kyi zhal zas bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs:༙ zag med ye shes bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho las:༙ sku lnga ye shes lnga yi sprin phung gtib:༙ 'dod pa'i yon tan rnam pa lnga ru 'phros:༙ longs spyod sna tshogs mchod pa'i sprin du gyur:༙ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥswā hā:༙ gsum pa spyan 'dren pa ni:༙ hūm̐:༙ 'og min chos dbyings dag pa'i pho brang nas:༙ dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad 'dus pa'i sku:༙ o rgyan chen po padma thod phreng rtsal:༙ rig 'dzin grub thob brgyud pa'i tshogs dang bcas:༙ hūm̐:༙ zla gam dbang chen rol pa'i pho brang nas:༙ pha rgyud g.yo ba rlung gi he ru ka:༙ dbang chen rta mchog yi dam lha yi tshogs:༙ hūm̐:༙ gsang chen rol pa chos 'byung dkyil 'khor nas:༙ ma rgyud bde ba nyams kyi rnal 'byor ma:༙ rdo rje phag mo ma mo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs:༙ hūm̐:༙ thar pa'i grong mchog nyi shu rtsa bzhi nas:༙ bla med bde stong phrin las bzhi yi bdag:༙ ye shes las grub chos skyong dam can tshogs:༙ hūm̐:༙ rtsa gsum dam can o rgyan lha yi tshogs:༙ ye shes tshogs la spyan 'dren 'dir byon cig:༙ rnam sprul mkha' la sprin ltar gtibs nas kyang:༙ ā rālli dang hūm̐ gi sgra sgrog cing:༙ rol mo sil snyan mang po si li li:༙ rin chen rus pa'i rgyan cha khra la la:༙ sna tshogs glu len gar byed khyugs se khyug:༙ 'dir gshegs zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes:༙ a la la ste dgyes par bzhes nas kyang:༙ smin grol mchog gi dngos grub bstsal du gsol:༙

de nas tshogs phud 'bul la:༙ hūm̐:༙ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor la:༙ gzugs kyi rdo rje mas kyang mchod pa'i phyir:༙ gzugs mdzes me tog spyan gyi mchod pa rnams:༙ rdo rje gzugs kyi lha mos thogs nas kyang:༙ phyogs bcu'i nam mkha' khyab par mngon sprul nas:༙ rdo rje'i bar du gsang ba'i glu blangs shing:༙ rdo rje'i bar du gsang ba'i gar bsgyur nas:༙ rnal 'byor tshogs mchod 'di 'bul bzhes su gsol:༙ hūm̐:༙ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor la:༙ sgra yi rdo rje mas kyang mchod pa'i phyir:༙ rol mo sil snyan snyan gyi mchod pa rnams:༙ rdo rje sgra yi lha mos thogs nas kyang:༙ phyogs bcu'i nam mkha' khyab par mngon sprul nas:༙ rdo rje'i bar du gsang ba'i glu blangs shing:༙ rdo rje'i bar du gsang ba'i gar bsgyur nas:༙ rnal 'byor tshogs mchod 'di 'bul bzhes su gsol:༙ hūm̐:༙ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor la:༙ dri yi rdo rje mas kyang mchod pa'i phyir:༙ dri mchog bdug spos shangs kyi mchod pa rnams:༙ rdo rje dri yi lha mos thogs nas kyang:༙ phyogs bcu'i nam mkha' khyab par mngon sprul nas:༙ rdo rje'i bar du gsang ba'i glu blangs shing:༙ rdo rje'i bar du gsang ba'i gar bsgyur nas:༙ rnal 'byor tshogs mchod 'di 'bul bzhes su gsol:༙ hūm̐:༙ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor la:༙ ro yi rdo rje mas kyang mchod pa'i phyir:༙ ro mchog zhal zas ljags kyi mchod pa rnams:༙ rdo rje ro yi lha mos thogs nas kyang:༙ phyogs bcu'i nam mkha' khyab par mngon sprul nas:༙ rdo rje'i bar du gsang ba'i glu blangs shing:༙ rdo rje'i bar du gsang ba'i gar bsgyur nas:༙ rnal 'byor tshogs mchod 'di 'bul bzhes su gsol:༙ hūm̐:༙ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor la:༙ reg bya rdo rje mas kyang mchod pa'i phyir:༙ reg bya bde mdzes sku yi mchod pa rnams:༙

rdo rje reg bya'i lha mos thogs nas kyang:༙ phyogs bcu'i nam mkha' khyab par mngon sprul nas:༙ rdo rje'i bar du gsang ba'i glu blangs shing:༙ rdo rje'i bar du gsang ba'i gar bsgyur nas:༙ rnal 'byor tshogs mchod 'di 'bul bzhes su gsol:༙ hūm̐:༙ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor la:༙ chos kyi rdo rje mas kyang mchod pa'i phyir:༙ bde stong gnyis med thugs kyi mchod pa rnams:༙ rdo rje chos kyi lha mos thogs nas kyang:༙ phyogs bcu'i nam mkha' khyab par mngon sprul nas:༙ rdo rje'i bar du gsang ba'i glu blangs shing:༙ rdo rje'i bar du gsang ba'i gar bsgyur nas:༙ rnal 'byor tshogs mchod 'di 'bul bzhes su gsol:༙ gu ru dhe ba ḍā ki nī ga ṇa tsakra pū tsa la kha raṃ khā hi:༙ de nas bar pa bshags pa ni:༙ ho:༙ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor lha:༙ sku gsung thugs dang yon tan phrin las bzhi:༙ rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig nyams pa rnams:༙ klong yangs chen po'i ngang du bzod par gsol:༙ de nas tha ma bsgral ba ni:༙ e yaṃ dza:༙ zhes gru gsum btson mun:༙ tri yaṃ dza:༙ zhes pas bgegs:༙ nṛ yaṃ dza:༙ zhes pas dgra bskyed:༙ hūm̐:༙ rang nyid rdo rje thod phreng rtsal:༙ sku las lha mo bzhi spros te:༙ lcags kyu dkar mos nam mkha' gang:༙ zhags pa ser mos bar snang gang:༙ lcags sgrog dmar mos sa gzhi gang:༙ dril bu ljang mos sa 'og gang:༙ thams cad gar nyams glog ltar 'khyug:༙ dam nyams dgra bgegs gar 'dug kyang:༙ lcags kyus zungs la zhags pas chings:༙ lcags sgrog sdoms la dril bus myos:༙ rang dbang med par 'dir khug cig:༙ oṃ badzra aṃ ku sha dza:༙ badzra pā sha hūm̐:༙ badzra spho ṭa baṃ:༙ badzra gaṇḍe ho:༙ ho:༙ gzugs la phob cig:༙ rnam par chings shig:༙ byad du chugs shig:༙ gnyis med du sres shig:༙ mgon skyabs byed pa'i lha thams cad dang phrol cig:༙ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho:༙ pra be sha ya phaṭa:༙ de nas bsgral ba ni:༙

hūm̐:༙ bdag ni rdo rje thod phreng rtsal:༙ zhing bcu bsgral bar thugs bskyed pas:༙ sku las mtshon cha skar ltar 'khrugs:༙ gsung las drag sngags 'brug ltar sgrog:༙ thugs las nus pa me ltar 'bar:༙ dam nyams dgra bgegs rdul du rlog:༙ sha khrag rus pa nang rol phrol:༙ rnam shes srog dang phyes byas nas:༙ bde chen rgyal ba'i zhing du bkod:༙ hūm̐ phaṭa:༙ de nas bstab pa ni:༙ hūm̐:༙ dgra yi phung po 'od du zhu:༙ bdud rtsi ro rgya'i kha zas gyur:༙ bla ma rig 'dzin zhal du bstab:༙ byin rlabs dbang bzhi bdag la skur:༙ yi dam lha tshogs zhal du bstab:༙ mchog gi siddhi pha la stsol:༙ mkha' 'gro chos skyong zhal du bstab:༙ thun mong phrin las rnam bzhi sgrubs:༙ oṃ āḥhūm̐:༙ dam nyams rnams kyi gti mug sha la kha raṃ khā hi:༙ zhe sdang rus la kha raṃ= 'dod chags khrag la kha raṃ= dug gsum dbyings su dag par gyis:༙ de nas rdo rje slob dpon la drang ba ni:༙ ho:༙ rdo rje slob dpon tshogs kyi bdag:༙ bram ze khyi dang gdol pa phag:༙ rang bzhin gcig par rnam par dag:༙ bde stong chen por da rol cig:༙ lan 'debs pa:༙ ho:༙ rin thang med las legs 'ong chos:༙ gzung dang 'dzin pa kun bral ba'i:༙ chos kun bde ba chen po'i ngang:༙ de bzhin nyid du a la la:༙ de nas lhag ma bsngo ba ni:༙ oṃ āḥhūm̐ utstshiṣṭa ba liṃ ta bhakṣa khā hi:༙ zhes bdun gyis bsngo/ tshigs bcad kyis btang ba ni:༙ hūm̐:༙ dang po phud kyis rtsa gsum mchod:༙ lus can kun gyi skyabs gnas yin:༙ bdag cag skyabs 'og tshud par mdzod:༙ bar du snang srid mgron la 'gyed:༙ snang srid ma lus dgyes gyur nas:༙ bdag cag bsod nams rdzogs par shog:༙ tha ma lhag ma mi btang rgyu:༙ byang chub lam la bar chad dang:༙ bdag cag bar chad rkyen ngan zlog:༙ lhag ma lan chags mi bsngo rgyu:༙ rgyu 'bras chos la bslu ba med:༙ bdag cag lan chags bu lon sob:༙ hūm̐:༙ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro yi:༙

srung ma lhag la dgyes pa rnams:༙ lhag ma'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la:༙ bstan pa srungs la bstan dgra sod:༙ hūm̐:༙ snang srid lha 'dre srid pa'i tshogs:༙ zas dang skom la dgyes pa rnams:༙ 'dod yon longs spyod 'di bzhes la:༙ phyi nang rkyen ngan bar chod sol:༙ hūm̐:༙ phung po lan chags lhag len tshogs:༙ sha khrag drod dbugs dgyes pa rnams:༙ dam rdzas lhag ma 'di bzhes la:༙ phung khams sgyu ma'i 'dre gdon thul:༙ hūm̐:༙ dkyil 'khor bka' yi srung ma'i tshogs:༙ dur khrod ma mo mkha' 'gro rnams:༙ mchod lhag tshogs 'khor 'di bzhes la:༙ bstan dgra thal ba rdul du rlog:༙ sarba ḍā ki nī sa ma ya i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi:༙ zhes phul:༙ de nas bskul ba ni:༙ hūm̐:༙ chos dbyings dur khrod gsang ba mchog gi gnas:༙ chos sku skye ba med pa'i ngang nyid nas:༙ gzugs sku rol pa padma thod phreng rtsal:༙ khyod ni 'chi med rdo rje'i sku brnyes nas:༙ ma 'ongs 'gro ba'i don phyir thugs bskyed pa'i:༙ thugs dam dus la bab po phrin las mdzod:༙ hūm̐:༙ gu ru'i sku yi dkyil 'khor chen po nas:༙ sangs rgyas byang sems 'gro don thugs bskyed pa'i:༙ bla ma rig 'dzin bka' brgyud grub thob bskor:༙ dpral ba chos 'byung klad mtsho'i dur khrod nas:༙ 'jam dpal khro bo nā ga raksha la:༙ 'jam dpal sku yi khro bo 'bum phrag bskor:༙ mgrin pa dbang chen gsung gi dur khrod nas:༙ padma gsung mchog dregs pa rta mgrin la:༙ padma gsung mchog khro bo 'bum phrag bskor:༙ thugs ka chos dbyings 'og min pho brang nas:༙ thugs mchog kun bzang rdo rje 'dzin pa la:༙ sku gsum ye shes dkyil 'khor 'bum phrag bskor:༙ lte ba dur khrod rtsub 'gyur tshal chen nas:༙ dpal ldan ye shes gsung gi mgon po la:༙ chos skyong pho rgyud mo rgyud 'bum phrag bskor:༙ gsang gnas rtsub 'gyur tshal gyi dur khrod nas:༙ 'jigs byed che mchog mgon po rā hu la:༙

snang srid lha srin sde brgyad 'bum phrag bskor:༙ dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la:༙ thugs dam bskul lo thugs bskyed dus la bab:༙ sku mchog 'jam dpal lus kyi bar chad zlog:༙ padma dbang chen dbang gi dngos grub stsol:༙ kun bzang rdor 'dzin sems la ting 'dzin skyed:༙ dpal ldan mgon pos bstan pa'i chag sgo zlog:༙ gza' bdud chen pos dgra bgegs rdul du rlog:༙ yid la bsam pa'i don 'di khyod kyis sgrubs:༙ hūm̐:༙ ko'u rī ma mo brgyad kyi thugs dam bskul:༙ tshogs brgyad gnas brgyad bar chad ma lus zlog:༙ phyogs skyong lha dang gshin rje klu gnod sbyin:༙ me lha srin po rlung dang 'byung po che:༙ sa bdag nyi zla dregs pa bcu yi tshogs:༙ thugs dam bskul lo bstan pa gnyan po srungs:༙ phyi nang bar chad dgra gdon byad ma zlog:༙ ma hā gu ru 'gro ba'i gnyen gcig pu:༙ thugs rje'i thugs dam byin rlabs dus 'dir dgongs:༙ dngos grub ma chung nus mthu dgra la phob:༙ bsam pa sgrubs la re ba'i blo 'di sgrubs:༙ rnal 'byor bcol pa'i phrin las bsgrub tu gsol:༙ ces 'bul:༙ chad mdo ni:༙ hūm̐:༙ sngon tshe 'das dus bskal pa'i thog ma la:༙ rang bzhin rnam dag chos dbyings pho brang du:༙ thog ma'i ston pa kun tu bzang po yis:༙ rang byung 'od lnga'i dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tshe:༙ 'gro 'dul sprul pa'i cho 'phrul bstan pa'i dus:༙ rigs lnga yi dam mkha' 'gro ma mo yis:༙ cir snang rang grol gtor ma blang ba dang:༙ dug lnga'i dgra bgegs bsgral bar ma chad dam:༙ sngon tshe zhal bzhes dam las ma 'da' bar:༙ 'khor 'das dbyer med gtor ma 'di bzhes la:༙ thugs dam rgyud bskul bcol pa'i phrin las mdzod:༙ hūm̐:༙ de 'og bar gyi bskal pa'i bar ma la:༙ rgyu rkyen ma grub padma 'byung gnas kyis:༙ mos pa'i blos bzung dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tshe:༙ sems nyid rang gzugs cho 'phrul bstan pa'i tshe:༙

gzung 'dzin re dogs lha 'dre thams cad kyis:༙ snang srid ye grol gtor ma blang ba dang:༙ rnam g.yeng dgra bgegs bsgral bar ma chad dam:༙ sngon tshe zhal bzhes dam las ma 'da' bar:༙ dran snang rang grol gtor ma 'di bzhes la:༙ thugs dam rgyud bskul bcol pa'i phrin las mdzod:༙ hūm̐:༙ de 'og dus kyi bskal pa'i tha ma la:༙ sbas yul chen po gsang sngags pho brang du:༙ rig 'dzin chen po padma thod phreng rtsal:༙ shes rab gsang yum mkha' 'gro mtsho rgyal gyis:༙ ma hā gu ru'i thugs kyi dkyil 'khor du:༙ theg chen gsang sngags dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tshe:༙ mkha' 'gro ma mo chos skyong yul lha yis:༙ dgyes shing rang rang phyed gzugs bstan nas kyang:༙ dam rdzas gtor ma blang bar ma chad dam:༙ sgrub mchog rnal 'byor skyong bar zhal bzhes pa'i:༙ rig 'dzin bka' yi gtor ma 'di bzhes la:༙ rnal 'byor bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mdzod:༙ ma ma yo gi ni i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi:༙ de nas brtan ma skyong ba ni:༙ hūm̐:༙ rtsa gsum rigs 'dus o rgyan bka' nyan pa'i:༙ brtan ma skyong ma ma sring rgya mtsho'i tshogs:༙ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dam can chos skyong rnams:༙ sprul pa yang sprul rdzu 'phrul bsam mi khyab:༙ 'dod dgur bsgyur ba'i cha lugs cir yang ston:༙ zas su sha dang khrag la rngams shing dgyes:༙ las su sangs rgyas bstan pa gnyan po srungs:༙ dam tshig can rnams bsrung zhing stongs grogs mdzod:༙ o rgyan bka' yi gtor ma 'di bzhes la:༙ bstan pa'i rgyud srungs sgrub pa'i phrin las mdzod:༙ pra mo ha ma ma la la le le:༙ sring 'gro ma i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi:༙ de nas rta bro ni:༙ hūm̐:༙ bzhengs shig dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams:༙ dpa' bo yab yum gnyis med sbyor:༙ gnyis med rol pa'i byin rlabs las:༙ bde ba chen po'i bro gcig brdungs:༙ gnod byed dgra bgegs ma lus gnon:༙ bro ni ye shes chen po'i bro:༙
